name: Hand-Held Extinguisher
description: Driver-reachable hand-held extinguisher on a metal quick-release mount (often required in addition to, or instead of, a plumbed system depending on series).

components.name: Hand-held extinguisher (≥ 2 lb / 1 kg)
components.description: Hand-held unit within reach of the belted driver. SCCA minimum: 2 lb Halon 1301/1211 or 2 lb dry chemical with positive charge gauge and 10 BC / 1A10BC rating; most racers use Novec/FK or AFFF units sized 2.5 lb / 1–2 kg.
components.location: On the cage near the driver's right knee / transmission tunnel, x ≈ 1.30, y ≈ 0.32, z ≈ +0.05.

raceOptions.name: Lifeline Zero 2000 / Zero FK hand-held 1.0–2.0 kg

specs.Gauge: Positive charge indicator required for dry chem

installNotes: Orient gauge visible to tech; pin installed.
inspection: Check gauge in green, weigh annually, service per label.

sources.title: SCCA Time Trials – Full Safety Rules

images.title: Lifeline Zero 360 2 kg hand-held (375 x 108 mm)

modelRef.dimensions: Lifeline Zero 360 2.0 kg: 375 mm long, 108 mm dia, 3.1 kg
modelRef.features: Red aluminium bottle, squeeze-lever head with gauge and pin; on the tunnel within the belted driver’s reach

components.name: Metal quick-release extinguisher mount
components.description: Billet aluminum or steel quick-release bracket (clamp-on to a cage tube or bolted to floor/tunnel). Plastic brackets are not acceptable – SCCA requires metal quick-release brackets.
components.location: Floor/tunnel or cage tube near driver.

hardware.spec: 1/4-20 UNC or M6 bolt + nyloc + backing washers / rivnuts
hardware.notes: Checked 2026-10: 10 N·m matches class 8.8 M6 (Atlas Copco). For 1/4-20 Grade 5-8, standard charts give about 8-14 ft-lb. Into rivnuts, stay at or below the rivnut maker's maximum. Upgraded to typical.

installNotes: Mount must hold the bottle in a crash – through-bolt with backing plates.
inspection: Check mount tight and release functional.

sources.title: SCCA Time Trials – Full Safety Rules

modelRef.dimensions: ~220 x 116 mm base, two metal quick-release straps
modelRef.features: Metal quick-release bracket (SCCA/NASA: no plastic mounts)
